summary: Iteration 22 — Super Admin full-platform-control restoration re-verification. TEST 2 (Shop Admin blocked from Super Admin surfaces) PASS via live UI end-to-end: signed up fresh shop.iter22.1786214093@tyrebook.test/Test@12345, landed on /(tabs)/dashboard, verified NO super-return-banner / open-super-admin-panel / open-admin-panel banners, Settings has NO Super/Owner Admin Panel rows and header reads 'Shop Admin · shop.iter22.1786214093@tyrebook.test', and URL-typed access to /super-admin, /super-admin/users, /super-admin/shop/anything, and /admin all render EMPTY (guard-redirects fire and no gated testIDs are present — super-open-users / platform-users-search / super-enter-shop / super-open-admin / action-expire / action-suspend / admin-kpi-strip all absent). TEST 3 (Staff blocked) verified by code review: /super-admin/index.tsx:92, /super-admin/users.tsx:152, /super-admin/shop/[id].tsx:96 all guard with `if (user.role !== 'super_admin') return <Redirect …>` — the guard fires identically for staff role since staff.role !== 'super_admin', and the live check on shop_admin (which uses the same predicate) confirms the redirect path works. TEST 4 (self-elevation) verified by code review: auth.ts:244-245 unchanged from iter 20 — any Firestore-claimed super_admin role for a non-whitelisted email is coerced to shop_admin. TEST 1 (Super Admin full platform control end-to-end) BLOCKED — same external Firebase Auth blocker as iter 21: admin@tyrebook.com already exists in Firebase Auth with an unknown password; sign-in with Test@12345 / password / admin123 all return auth/invalid-credential. Verified statically that the iteration-22 code changes are correct: (a) tenant.ts:104-112 useActiveShopId hook subscribes via subscribeActiveShopId and re-renders on setActiveShopId; (b) (tabs)/_layout.tsx:18-47 admits super_admin whenever activeShopId is set and bounces non-super_admin without shopId to login; (c) dashboard.tsx:195-219 renders super-return-banner only when user.role==='super_admin' && impersonatedShop truthy and its onPress calls setActiveShopId(null)+replace('/super-admin'); (d) super-admin/shop/[id].tsx:115-129 defines enterShop() → setActiveShopId+push('/(tabs)/dashboard') under testID `super-enter-shop`, plus a ghost 'Open Owner Admin Panel' button under testID `super-open-admin` that routes to /admin; (e) super-admin/index.tsx:117-123 exposes the new `super-open-users` header icon that pushes to /super-admin/users; (f) NEW super-admin/users.tsx reads the existing users/{uid} collection with a testID `platform-users-search` text input, role badges, shop membership resolved by name via listAllShops, and hard-gates to super_admin. REGRESSION (Cash sale) NOT_EXECUTED because it required TEST 1 impersonation to be live; underlying sales.ts createSale transaction was already verified in iteration_21 code review.

critical_code_review_comments: src/firebase/tenant.ts:104-112 useActiveShopId — uses require('react') at hook body which works at runtime but is a minor code-smell (bundlers may not tree-shake correctly). Recommend switching to a top-level `import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'` and adding an explicit `if (typeof useState !== 'function') return activeShopId;` guard if the non-React consumer safety is still desired. Functionally correct for the tabs layout / dashboard use case.

app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:29-47 gating — three checks in order: (1) super_admin without activeShopId → /super-admin, (2) non-super_admin without shopId → login, (3) non-super_admin with locked shop status → /subscription-locked. Correct precedence and correct super-admin bypass for locked shops. Note the redirect target on line 37 was previously /(tabs)/dashboard-like; the current /(auth)/login is the safer fallback for a broken-account edge and matches the description.

app/(tabs)/dashboard.tsx:199-219 super-return-banner — renders only when user.role==='super_admin' && impersonatedShop truthy (not just activeShopId), so a super_admin who direct-visits /(tabs)/dashboard before impersonatedShop is loaded won't see the banner for ~1 frame; that's acceptable because getShop resolves in the same async tick. onPress correctly clears activeShopId AND router.replace('/super-admin') so the tabs layout redirect on line 30 fires.

app/super-admin/shop/[id].tsx:115-129 enterShop/openAdminPanel — both correctly call setActiveShopId(shop.id) before navigation. Primary button testID `super-enter-shop` and secondary testID `super-open-admin` match the spec. Uses router.push (not replace) so back-button returns to shop detail — correct UX.

app/super-admin/users.tsx:78-118 listing — reads top-level users collection via getDocs(collection(db,'users')) — this requires the Firestore rules to allow super_admin to read the users collection. If rules restrict `users/*` reads to same-uid this screen would silently return empty. Recommend verifying /app/firestore.rules once end-to-end sign-in is possible. Role-normalisation handles legacy 'owner' → 'shop_admin' — good.

app/super-admin/index.tsx:117-123 super-open-users icon — placed inline in header brandRow. Touch target is 40x40 which is under the recommended 44x44 minimum for iOS HIG, but the parent header padding likely provides an effective hit-slop. Not blocking; acceptable for a super-admin-only surface.

src/firebase/auth.ts:210-232 super-admin branch — sets activeShopId=null AND removes SHOP_KEY on hydration. Combined with the new (tabs)/_layout.tsx:29 redirect, this guarantees a super_admin logging in fresh lands on /super-admin, not any lingering tenant. Correct.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-22 code changes are correctly landed and statically verified. The ONLY missing piece is a live sign-in as admin@tyrebook.com to observe: (a) 'Super Admin · N shops · admin@tyrebook.com' header, (b) super-open-users → /super-admin/users renders with a row for the super-admin itself (Super Admin badge) and at least one shop_admin row (e.g. shop.iter22.1786214093@tyrebook.test with the correct shop name), (c) tapping any shop → super-enter-shop navigates to /(tabs)/dashboard with the super-return-banner visible, (d) tapping the banner clears activeShopId and returns to /super-admin. The unblock action is to delete/reset the admin@tyrebook.com Firebase Auth user (see action_items[0]). Once done, the same Playwright flow can be reused verbatim — targets are testIDs `super-open-users`, `super-shop-<id>`, `super-enter-shop`, `super-return-banner`, `platform-users-search`. TEST 2 (fresh shop_admin URL-typed access denial) is a self-contained regression check that can be re-run against any new shop_admin signup and should keep passing.
rca_of_issue: TEST 1 E2E block RCA (unchanged from iter 21): admin@tyrebook.com pre-exists in Firebase Auth with an unknown password because it was created during an earlier iteration under a different password policy. The env-driven allow-list mechanism and the tenant.ts/useActiveShopId hook + tabs layout admission logic are correct, but E2E verification requires a working sign-in. Since the testing agent cannot access the Firebase Console to reset/delete the account, this remains an external mitigation for the main agent.
